Qt Branded Template Example

Exercises the Qt-branded page template with toolbar and CDN logo.

Markdown
Ask AI
C Explain with Claude G Explain with ChatGPT

This page exists to validate that the template generator, when pointed at an external template directory, renders the Qt brand layer correctly: dark header, Qt green accents, CDN logo, three-button toolbar with Claude and ChatGPT as the only AI providers, and the Qt copyright footer. The neutral default templates remain untouched; branding is applied solely through TemplateHTML.templatedir.
